method: Capacity partition of a shared footprint; entropy-smoothed dual then greedy residual correction

flow.limit: Flow supplies sites and a raster footprint, not final country boundaries or quotas. Empty raster components use one representative sample. Raster samples may overlap. Each target landmass receives the original requested budget. Isolated source-shaped templates are translated away from the raw mainland footprint before partitioning.

flow_guide_cost: Weighted squared distance from the raw flow-region raster, added to uniform squared site distance

envelope.limit: A fixed experimental occupancy target, not a source coastline. Gaussian smoothing and an area quota move the outer boundary as well as filling gaps. The target can have several parts. Fixed islands and their side-neighbour cells are excluded. Countries keep separate budgets in the deformation solver.

limit: Diagnostic only. No connectivity, border, or hole constraint. Exact counts and footprint occupancy are not approval. Residual correction is greedy, not an optimality certificate. The footprint can remove real coasts or fill real water.
